page.title: What Needs You
page.purpose: Answer one question on arrival: is anything waiting on me right now, and what is it. Everything else on this page is secondary to that.

priorities.statement: Open handoffs come first and are never below the fold — a blocked flow is the only thing on this page with a deadline.
A persona that is degraded (expiring document, failing mailbox, dead code route) is surfaced before it breaks a flow, not after.
Counts are never the headline. 'Three things need you' is less useful than naming the oldest one.
The page must be honest when a dependency is down: a stale view is labelled stale rather than shown as current.
priorities.notes: agent-manager unreachable means act-as is refused system-wide; the operator learns that here first.

states.description: At least one handoff is open and at least one persona is configured.
No personas exist yet. The page becomes a single call to create the first one, not an empty grid.
Personas exist and nothing is blocked. This is the success state and should read as calm, not as missing data.
Handoffs load but persona health does not, or the reverse. Each region reports its own failure without blanking the page.
A dependency is unreachable and the view is older than its refresh interval. Explicitly labelled with its age.
First paint before either region resolves.
The API is unreachable. The page says so plainly and offers retry.
